newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian forex reserves up by $2.29 bln in 1996 - RBI.
newsitem.headline: Indian forex reserves up by $2.29 bln in 1996 - RBI.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Wednesday its foreign currency assets rose by $2.29 billion in calendar year 1996.
"During the current financial year (April-March) so far, the foreign currency assets increased by $2.71 billion," it said.
The foreign currency assets stood at $19.76 billion on December 31, 1996 against $17.04 billion on March 31, 1996 and $17.47 billion on December 31, 1995, it said in a statement.
